title: Chainmail Armor Recipe
description: A data pack that adds crafting for chainmail armor, only iron ingots and nuggets are used, without chains.
body: This mod adds the ability to create chainmail armor, that's all. Iron ingots and nuggets are used for crafting, which reduces iron consumption and makes the crafting process easier. If you use chains, it will be much more expensive than regular iron armor, chain mail is the same iron armor, but with less iron.
